# Ideas for the assistant

- Calendar should come first, because it is the one thing I open every single day and it needs to work with the calendars I already use
- He should be curious about my life, for example asking how the dentist went a week after I mention it
- I want him on the laptop as well as the phone, so that it feels like one assistant wherever I happen to be sitting
- He should not just wait for commands; if he notices the oven timer is about to go off he can say so without being asked
- When I ask for something silly he should play along for a moment and then actually do it properly, and know what he is good at
- When I change a list he should notice what is new and offer to help with it later on
- When the room is quiet he should lower his voice without me having to ask for it
- Remember to look at how real secretaries keep their notes, and talk to one if I can find someone willing
- Maybe ask a comedy writer to read his lines, since the humour is the whole point of having a character at all
- The timer has to be reliable, and I should be able to set one with my hands full while I am cooking dinner
